info.name: Avariel
info.description: The construction for my custom Avariel subrace for elves.
info.author: Gustavo Schip

description.p: The avariel are winged elves. These rare creatures were more common when the worlds of the multiverse were young, but frequent conflicts with dragons much reduced the winged elves’ number. Still, a few colonies persist here and there in the Material Plane and on the Plane of Air.

Wings.You have a pair of wings that grant you a flying speed of 30 feet. Broad and feathered, they can span up to 10 feet when fully extended. To use this flying speed, you can't be wearing medium or heavy armor
Languages.You can speak, read, and write Auran.
